verdict.rationale: Flagsmith Experimentation ingests events from your application into a managed data warehouse and analyses them with a built-in Bayesian engine, which covers the ingested-events path. There is no documentation of defining custom metrics on those events or of querying your own warehouse tables. The 'your own analytics platform' option is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented metric definition from ingested events, warehouse-native metrics on customer-owned tables, transparency into metric computation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can define experiment metrics from my own data — warehouse tables or ingested events — instead of a black-box metric store

citations.quote: collect events from your application into a managed data warehouse, and read the results with a built-in Bayesian statistics engine.
